nodes.name: Solution casting of SSPE membranes
nodes.procedure: P(SSPSILi-alt-MA) was synthesized by the method in our previous work [9] and put into dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) with PEO (1,000,000 g mol⁻¹) until they are fully dissolved. The gained transparent solution was then poured into a flat Teflon dish, and the solvent was evaporated at 70 °C. Subsequently, the obtained membranes were dried at 80 °C in a vacuum oven. The prepared SSPE membranes were punched into circles for electrochemical tests, with the diameter of 19 mm.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns show complete destruction of P(SSPSILi-alt-MA) crystallinity and decreased PEO crystallinity with transformation of crystallographic planes from (032), (120) to (101), (021) with increased plane distances.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 3 comparatively shows the XRD patterns of the prepared SSPE membranes containing different amounts of P(SSPSILi-alt-MA)... the intensities peaks standing for the neat PEO decrease rapidly with rising contents of P(SSPSILi-alt-MA)

nodes.characterization_summary: DSC shows glass transition temperature (Tg) of 20 wt% SSPE membrane at -11.6 °C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 4a comparatively shows the DSC traces of the SSPE membranes containing various weight ratio of P(SSPSILi-alt-MA)... the 10 wt%, 20 wt% and 30 wt% SSPE membrane all show the lower Tg than the room temperature, about -28.5, -11.6 and 14.8 °C

nodes.characterization_summary: TGA shows thermal decomposition temperature approximately 400 °C for all SSPE membranes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: According to the TG plots, all the prepared SSPE membranes present super high temperatures of thermal decomposition (approximately 400 °C)

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS shows ionic conductivity of 3.08 × 10^-4 S cm^-1 at room temperature and 1.84 × 10^-3 S cm^-1 at 80 °C for 20 wt% SSPE membrane.
nodes.evidence_snippet: It is clear that the 20 wt% SSPE membrane presents the highest values of ion conductivity (3.08 × 10^-4 S cm^-1 at room temperature and 1.84 × 10^-3 S cm^-1 at 80 °C)

nodes.characterization_summary: Potentiostatic DC polarization combined with AC impedance shows lithium transference number t_Li^+ = 0.97 at 80 °C for 20 wt% SSPE membrane.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 6a shows the polarization curve and plots of impedance before and after polarization and the t_Li^+ value of the 20 wt% SSPE membrane at 80 °C was calculated to be 0.97 according to the parameters in Tab S1.

nodes.characterization_summary: LSV shows electrochemical window up to ~5.0 V (vs. Li/Li^+) at 80 °C for 20 wt% SSPE membrane.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The resultant LSV curve (Fig. S6, Supporting Information) at 80 °C shows a significant rising current at the potential up to ~5.0 V (vs. Li/Li^+)
